_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#12. Measured on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, 2026-08-06, wall time 2 s: lagrange(gridView, order=0) raises KeyError 'Parameter error in LagrangeSpace with order=0: order has to be greater or equal to 1' — a parameter-validation sentence, not a Python one, which is why it is easy to misread as a bug in the caller. dglagrange(gridView, order=0).size == 16 and finiteVolume(gridView).size == 16 on a 4x4 grid, i.e. exactly one dof per cell, which is what the FEniCS ('DG', 0) habit was asking for.
expect_in_output: order has to be greater or equal to 1
